Field Descriptions

SAMPLES_PROCESSED

Number of 3-bit samples processed in current window (0-170). Used for window initialization and wraparound tracking. Pattern count is valid when this reaches 170.

TARGET_PATTERN

Current 3-bit target pattern being tracked (0b000 through 0b111). Hardware automatically selects the most common pattern. Read to identify which 3-bit value is dominant.

PATTERN_COUNT

Current count of the most frequently occurring 3-bit pattern in the sliding 170-sample window. For good entropy, expect ~21 (12.5% of 170). Values >28 indicate potential bias. Compare to APT_PROPORTION_3BIT.LIMIT. Updates continuously as window slides.
